accepted_state: DEDAL 0.39.1 retains creative skill ownership while adding causal scene design, event-based source planning, observed evidence and explicit source-only motion handoff; media outcomes remain unmeasured.
DEDAL 0.38.4 treats lexical routing as candidates only; a task-bound semantic decision is required for profile activation, and receipt v4 checks route and read-before-gate chronology.

DEDAL 0.38.3 uses one primary plus bounded supporting skills per task profile, a fail-closed direct-tree release digest manifest, and release-bound receipt v3 coverage; semantic ambiguity remains for judgment.

DEDAL 0.38.3 classifies every Core file through index/document-schema.yaml; machine contracts are normative, active SKILL.md instruction bodies retain authority, and explanatory Markdown is supporting context.
DEDAL 0.38.3 boots from the direct /DEDAL/core Library tree; YAML/JSON contracts and state/checkpoint.yaml are authoritative, chat memory is not.

DEDAL 0.38.3 separates structural readiness from session-specific profile receipt coverage; receipt references are traceable claims and do not independently prove actual Library reads or pixel binding.
A conservative lexical profile probe detects explicit and ambiguous phrase matches; unresolved tasks require semantic routing judgment.
External DEDAL Runtime and Python Canary MCP sidecars are retired and must not be used for boot, routing, hydration, authorization, or continuity; historical artifacts are evidence only.
Execution-critical task profiles declare mandatory dependency hydration and readiness gates; skill entrypoint activation alone is not execution readiness.
DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with the always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
GitHub is authoritative for public Core history; /DEDAL/core is the direct Library working and boot tree. Reconcile a sanitized diff against the recorded Git base before upstream sync.

Optional Library-only private operational overlays may provide Creator/project-specific non-secret context while remaining outside public Git synchronization and subordinate to live authoritative state.

YouTube Publishing engineering for the current scope is capability-complete; authenticated YouTube operations remain owned by YouTube Publishing, canonical OAuth behavior is source-synchronized, and deployment credentials/config remain private live state that must be verified rather than inferred.

YouTube SEO owns downstream discovery-surface strategy, packaging, analytics diagnosis, experiments and measurement learning; YouTube Reporting Reach has been production-validated and delayed/missing early data is represented with availability states rather than fake zeroes.
Candidate Video Finder is an independently routable upstream discovery faculty whose atomic object is a specific bounded scene/event, not an entire movie, season or episode.
Candidate Video Finder requires source/scene truth, channel relevance, duplicate/truth/evidence/risk hard gates and preserves an evidence vector rather than hiding uncertainty in a magic score.

Candidate Video Finder stops before exact local cutting, SEO packaging, visual production or YouTube mutation; those remain owned by Video Post-Production, YouTube SEO, Visual Narrative Production and YouTube Publishing respectively.
Creator selection remains explicit through SELECT/MAYBE/PASS/HOLD/NEVER and channel/Creator-specific candidate learning remains in the private operational overlay.
Copyright/reuse handling is risk triage only; Candidate Video Finder does not claim legal clearance, copyright safety or guaranteed fair use.

Candidate Video Finder surfaces a verified decision visual aid for each shortlisted candidate when the evidence chain exposes a usable scene page, preview, official clip, or direct media URL; omission is not allowed when a usable aid exists, and links never imply reuse rights or final cut suitability.

Creator Google Drive video masters follow rough/source -> sandbox edit -> Edited Videos -> verified YouTube publication -> Uploaded YT Videos; archive movement occurs only after authoritative publishing verification.

YouTube upload orchestration uses a persistent isolated outbound-polling runner: normal upload submission auto-picks queued jobs without per-job GitHub Actions, while idempotency, ownership, private-first intent gates, bounded read-back, and verification remain authoritative.

DEDAL Self-Improvement is an independently routable meta-faculty for correction/regression learning closure: durable fixes require applicable runtime repair, canonical-source reconciliation, regression coverage, correctly scoped durable learning, continuity state, and independent verification before full closure.

Self-Improvement durable candidates are triaged as discard/improve/merge/create; captured lessons progress through explicit maturity states and broad promotion requires recurrence, held-out, transfer, or equivalent severity-appropriate evidence rather than one-session intuition.

Facebook Page Management is an independently routable specialist for authenticated Page content, media, scheduling, engagement/moderation, analytics and administration; personal-profile automation remains out of scope and Messenger fails closed unless fresh inbound state and compliant sending are live-verified.
Effectiveness-hygiene maintenance closes registry/CI coverage drift and moves the next Core phase from skill-count expansion to black-box outcome evaluation.

Video Post-Production now distinguishes Simple / Narrative Edit from Fan / Visual-Montage Edit; both require a structure-first rough before final effects polish, while the selected mode determines whether source meaning/chronology or a target visual motif is primary.

YouTube Publishing uses risk-tiered viewer-comment engagement: low-risk positive replies may be autonomous, sensitive or contested replies default to neutral factual framing and uncertainty discipline with Creator review when materially escalatory, and disagreement alone is not grounds for destructive moderation.

Medicine Store Assistant treats an established Master Data ledger as a values-only closed-month historical snapshot layer outside the four live operational surfaces; archive verification precedes destructive month-close cleanup, and derived history must not double-count archived months.

Medicine Store Assistant uses the authorized Google workbook as the canonical routine working source after migration; legacy Excel is reference/migration/historical/export evidence and is not a routine synchronization dependency.

Medicine Store Assistant uses stable local fallback identifiers for known local item identities without CMS codes; one local code is permanently bound to one identity, may span that identity's multiple lots, is never reused, and remains historical lineage after later CMS replacement.

YouTube authenticated analytics/Reporting acquisition and provider transport are owned by YouTube Publishing; analytics diagnosis/experiment/learning are owned by YouTube SEO, and combined acquisition+diagnosis uses Publishing as PRIMARY with SEO as SUPPORTING.

Medicine Store Assistant warning markers use a false-alarm prevention gate: code misses trigger name/description/specification reconciliation, legitimate multi-brand sibling lots and known departmental namespaces are allowed, stale markers are cleaned instead of re-raised, and yellow/red severity requires residual uncertainty or concrete contradiction.

YouTube Publishing treats Edited Videos and Uploaded YT Videos as rolling working storage with a default newest-three usable-video window per folder; unresolved publishing/recovery/enforcement states override retention count, and destructive cleanup requires exact target resolution plus post-delete read-back.

YouTube new-publication workflow requires a locked viewer-facing launch package before upload transport unless the Creator explicitly supplied the complete final package; YouTube Publishing remains PRIMARY, YouTube SEO becomes SUPPORTING when packaging is unresolved, and Shorts are explicitly not exempt.

Video Post-Production first-pass footage editing uses explicit coverage mapping before a serious rough, treats duration/resolution/audio/ending/thumbnail-source quality as deliberate review decisions, and pilots strong AI enhancement before full rendering to reduce avoidable Creator correction loops.

YouTube upload failover is single-flight: queued auto-pickup work remains live duplicate risk, so runner/job state must be diagnosed and the prior job neutralized before any replacement job or independent direct-provider fallback; provider IDs require authoritative read-back and publication closure waits for processed state.

YouTube Publishing defaults to direct multipart private-first upload with authoritative ID/processing/final read-back; the persistent runner is secondary/recovery and requires fresh heartbeat plus runner-accessible source evidence before job creation.
Persistent YouTube runner terminal source-resolution errors are acknowledged as failed queued jobs before upload claim so an invalid source cannot head-of-line block later valid work.

Persistent YouTube runner is a health-gated secondary/recovery path: fresh poll heartbeat, standalone Drive retrieval, terminal source-failure queue advancement, and valid private Drive auto-pickup E2E have been live revalidated; direct multipart remains the default Creator-facing upload path.
Visual Direction has been migrated into the canonical Visual Narrative Production faculty; visual-direction remains a backward-compatible alias rather than a duplicate owner.

Story Weaver independently owns fiction canon, scene/beat causality, dialogue and character-state continuity; Visual Narrative Production consumes accepted story truth for still-image/visual-novel shot production.

Visual Narrative Production uses role-specific reference authority, structured shot specs and Visual Continuity Ledgers so identity/physique/performance, environment, camera-axis/screen-direction, lighting, props and scene-state deltas are not left to prompt memory.

Visual Narrative Production action/interaction QA treats limb count, joint mechanics, balance, grip, load, object contact/intersection and force direction as explicit defect classes, and prompt neutralization is semantic clarification only, never policy evasion.

Visual Narrative Production now uses a compact scene card and preflight/render/pixel-review/verified-delivery gates; tool capability and repeated-failure routing are explicit, while contract validation remains distinct from outcome evidence.

Visual Narrative Production successive mini-arcs use a local continuity envelope across 3–4 separate full-frame outputs, prioritize natural biomechanics and equipment geometry, and preserve accepted local state during narrow retries.
Visual Narrative Production now enforces persistent object count/morphology/spatial-state continuity and proficiency-aware movement-form realism across successive stills.
Generative Video Direction independently owns provider-neutral temporal shot design, reference-role/provider strategy, generation-contract compilation, generated-take QA and targeted repair.

Canonical video-production is renamed/refocused to video-post-production; video-production and video-editing remain compatibility aliases, and post-production owns existing-media edit/assembly/finish/delivery rather than generative motion prompting.

The creative moving-image bridge is Story Weaver -> Visual Narrative Production -> Generative Video Direction -> Video Post-Production, with a GVD -> VNP keyframe/reference return path when motion control needs a stronger visual state.

Visual Narrative Production now treats performer, support apparatus, and camera as one geometric system: support-axis alignment and contact-map coherence are explicit admission checks, and camera placement must reveal natural biomechanics without twisting the performer or skewing equipment.

File-mediated creative-agent collaboration uses a manifest-authoritative, version-pinned JSON handoff: DEDAL emits images_ready only after source-sequence validation, external agents reject stale manifests, and downstream failures return pair-specific bridge requests for narrow repair while private workspace details remain outside public Core.

Core 0.38.5 unifies essential readiness checks, supports explicit unavailable Library versions, and scopes gates to operation/phase; receipts remain coverage evidence, not independent source or outcome proof.
Wave B/C: typed evidence properties, phase/read reuse, compact verified loading and publication reconciliation; controlled outcome evaluation with explicit evidence boundaries.
unresolved_risks: The local Library mirror may lag live GitHub main and must be refreshed/reconciled before it is used as a mutation base.
Composio/GitHub aggregation auth can fail independently of GitHub repository state; a failed broker session must not be treated as repository failure.

Production OAuth credentials and deployment configuration remain private live state even though canonical no-page Authorization Code + PKCE behavior is now source-synchronized; consequential auth changes still require live verification.
Candidate Video Finder has contract-level validation but still needs broader representative live outcome evidence before learned weighting is promoted.
Copyright/reuse risk remains context- and rights-dependent; observed channel/platform signals are triage evidence, not legal certainty.
Google Drive folder names and IDs are operational/private state; public Core records only the generic lifecycle and must resolve exact IDs live before moves.
Self-Improvement v0.32.1 has external-method research plus contract/replay evidence, but long-run reduction in recurrence/rework remains future outcome evidence rather than a claimed result.

Facebook Messenger fresh-inbound synchronization is not currently live-verified on the tested connector: old thread history was readable but fresh inbound state was absent and a send was policy-blocked as outside the allowed window; Page content operations remain independently verified.
Visual Narrative Production 0.35.5 has contract validation plus one representative successful physical-action mini-arc; broader scene classes and lower-model transfer remain unproven.
Host-authenticated event capture/interception is unavailable; external judgments require authoritative tools or Creator acceptance.
Controlled replay evaluation does not establish general model quality, visual identity gains or live scheduled-service reliability.

next_executable_step.action: Run representative Story->Still->Motion->Edit provider workflows and measure usable-take, retry burden, and continuity outcomes before broad generative-video quality claims.
